digest.component_or_area: git timeout bounds enforcement across rebar modules
propositions: Network-capable git call sites in gerrit_client.py and workspace.py lack explicit timeout parameters and can block indefinitely on stuck remotes or hung credential helpers
subprocess.TimeoutExpired in gerrit_client.clone_change_ref bypasses the existing token-redaction handler, creating a credential-disclosure path via the unredacted fetch URL in TimeoutExpired.cmd

All six subprocess.run invocations across the two target modules must be bounded with _GIT_TIMEOUT=300 (matching the cold-fetch profile of task 747f rather than the 30s incremental profile of _store modules)
Two sites in _ref_lock.py are already structurally bounded by a required timeout keyword-only parameter and require no edit

A test suite must verify that both modules expose _GIT_TIMEOUT, all git calls receive timeout kwargs, and TimeoutExpired is converted to module-specific errors (GerritError and WorkspaceError) with operation and bound named and credentials scrubbed
